newsitem.title: USA: Crescent Real Estate plans special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Crescent Real Estate plans special dividend.

text.p: Crescent Real Estate Equities Co said Tuesday it will be making a special dividend to its shareholders in connection with the formation of its "spinoff" corporation, Crescent Operating Inc.

The special dividend is expected to be paid through the distribution of one share of Crescent Operating stock for 10 shares of Crescent stock and one share of Crescent Operating stock for every five operating partnership units.
The special dividend will be 10 cents to 15 cents per share based on the estimated value of certain assets Crescent Operating intends to acquire prior to the spinoff.
The distribution is expected to be made in June and prior to completion of Crescent's acquisition of about 90 behavioral-health-care facilities from Magellan Health Services Inc.

Holders who purchase shares of common stock in Crescent Real Estate's planned public offering will be entitled to receive the special dividend, so long as such shares continue to be held on the record date.

Following the spinoff, the company said the assets of Crescent Operating will consist principally of a 50 percent interest in a new company that will operate and lease the approximately 90 behavioral-health-care facilities from Crescent, 1.3 million warrants to acquire Magellan common stock and an approximately 12 percent partnership interest in the Dallas Mavericks NBA franchise.
Crescent also said it declared a cash dividend of $0.305 per share for the quarter ended March 31. This dividend will be payable May 14, to shareholders of record, April 30.

Holders who purchase shares of common stock in the company's planned public offering will be entitled to receive the dividend for the first quarter of 1997, so long as such shares continue to be held on the record date.
